column2: Oh no! How did this happen? Why would students from my school promote such violence toward others?
That is what I want to know! I'm sure that it has something to do with your school's international relationship policies!
Wait a minute, Hayato! You must not speak to him like that! We must try and listen to what they have to say.
I don't care where you came from! One must take responsibility for their actions! Well... Say something, you big guy!
Hmm... Are you challenging me?
(This is getting out of hand. If a teacher and a student fight, it will only bring more problem to me! I must stop them!)
...So we must all agree to cooperate with this investigation. Together we can discover the truth behind what happened.
Altough I do not want to, I must admit the fact that there was a scuffle. However, I will never believe our school is responsible! I'll prove it!
Whatever... You fools can do whatever you like. I'll do my own investigation! Adios!
Hee hee hee. I heard the news and it sounds interesting. Very interesting indeed. Please, let me go with you. I know that I can help!
You're not going to take NO for an answer are you? Fine... I suppose it will be safer for everyone, if we all work together.
Excellent! The Taiyo-Pacific United Investigation Group has now been formed! Let's move out!
It doesn't make sense... They are all top students who are good at both study and athletics. Why would they cause such chaos?
Thinking about it won't do any good. We must act first and question later!
And the first school that comes to mind when I think about fighting is Gedo High. Let's begin our investigation there!
It's not good to blame someone based upon an assumption. If you do, you may miss the truth of what you were hoping to discover.
Ha ha ha! It's too late for that suckers! We aren't going to let you get away with blaming us for that problem at Pacific High!
That's right! I am getting MAD!! What are we gonna do, leader?
...Destroy them...
Ga ha ha ha! That didn't make me feel much better!
Ha! If you keep trying to blame Gedo High, I won't pull my punches next time! Remember that suckers!
What was that all about...? I always heard that Daigo from {} was famous for being a man of honor...
Yes. It is very strange, but I felt such an evil intent from his fists. I'm sure he was the only one out of them who was serious about killing us.
If that is true, then their next target might be the Taiyo High students...
It would be disastrous if our school is attacked during Batsu and Hayato's absence... I must return to {} immediately!
Hey stop! It's too dangerous! You can't handle them!
Don't worry about me. I'll be fine. I'll be back after I warn all the students there.
Alright, I understand. You can leave the investigation to us. We will be able to handle it. Just be careful...
Thank you. Be good, OK?

column2: Judging from Daigo's attitude, I still think that the scuffle at the athletic competition must have been manipulated by {} students.
I do not believe that at all. There is no reason why they would lie to us.
Hi there! It seems like you're in trouble Boman.
Batsu! You've come just in time... What!? Ghhh...
Hey! What are you doin... Kyaah!
Ah! You two should have let things slide. It didn't have to be this way...
What's the matter with you, Batsu?! It's hard to believe it, but it seems that you are also being controlled by...
Shut up!
You don't know what's going on here Boman! I think you should just leave it alone. This is your only warning!
Hey! Wait up!
Who? Who dare to interfere with me?!
I'm not going to let you do this!
Boman! That guy is a fake! So beat him up!
That voice... Is it...
Roy! Tiffany!
That's right friend. But we can talk later! Right now, we got to dispose of these losers first!
#WORDS
column3: Gedo High|Taiyo High|Gedo High|Taiyo High|Justice High

column2: Hee hee hee! This isn't over yet losers!
You had better watch your back fools!
They've escaped! We'll have to deal with them later... So, when did you two come to Japan?
Wait a second! Why did you call Batsu a 'fake'. What did that mean?
My dad received a report saying something bad was going to happen at Pacific High. So... Umm... I was forced to come here.
Yeah whatever! You seemed to be really excited while making those travel preparations...
A... Anyway, I heard that this guy was pretending to be Batsu and was causing a lot of trouble throughout various parts of the country.
Does that mean that he caused the scuffle at the Taiyo-Pacific athletic competition?
Mmm... It's such a heinous crime to impersonate someone and ruin their good name! I will not let it go on any longer!
Why don't you tag along with me on my investigation? You won't cause too much trouble, will you?
You'll never change, huh? But I still trust you, so I'll join your team...
Perfect! I think the header for this should be, "United by fate! Friendships from overseas!"
Here you are! I've finally found you! Get ready to be beaten!
What? Shoma, what's the matter with you?
How come you're with that little girl?
Shoma, you know what happened. I did nothing wrong, and yet these guys suddenly attacked me...
What are you saying?! It was you who picked a fight with us!
Yes, it's true! Have you already forgotten what just happened!?
Oh, I see! You've gone crazy just like Batsu! What is wrong with everyone?! Am I the only one left who is sane?!
There's no point in trying to reason with him anymore. He's already made up his mind. Get ready, here he comes!
You're so weak minded...
That little girl ran away.
She must have some connection with the mastermind behind this chaos. She had some evil reason to sneak into Gorin High...
Oh... What was I thining... Why...? She looked so... So...
Wake up already!
Listen! Think about how many people you've hurt by trusting that evil girl!
I never knew there was a stone quarrying field near Justice High...
Don't let our location confuse you! We've got to stay alert! He must be close...!
Welcome! This is the final act! Now, it's time for all of you to die!!
I never imagined that our plan would allow you to strengthen your union. I must remember that for future reference...
Batsu?! ...No, you're the fake! If you were a true man, tell me who you really are!
Hee hee hee! Yes! You deserve to know the truth!
I am Kurow Kirishima! And we are from {}!
{}? Wow! That is SUCH a lame name for a gang!
Never mind about that! He is an assassin hired to eliminate the Imawano family!
Disguised as Batsu, he caused a scuffle at the athletic competition and has been destroying relationships between schools intending to isolate {}!
Hee hee hee... Well done, Roy Bromwell. But you forgot a few things...
Hyo Imawano failed to rule the country of Japan! He was weak, but I am strong! I will succeed where he has failed!
Then I'll destroy the Imawano family and take revenge against everyone who has underestimated me!
Why do all the crazy and insane people go to school at Justice High?
You must be punished!
No one is going to give you what you want! You're simply lost in your selfish dreams!
You... I saw you at Taiyo High!
You caused a lot of trouble by disguising yourself as Batsu...
And you destroyed our trust and friendship! I'll never forgive you!
Shut up, loser!
Hyo Imawano and {} have already fallen into my arms! You should follow them and surrender to me!
#WORDS
#WORDS
column3: Gedo High|Taiyo High|Gedo High|Taiyo High|Justice High

column2: Super! This is what we call a scoop! I've got a great shot, thank you!
W... why!? My plan was perfect! How could I lose to you...!?
...You've left me no choice but to use the power of Hyo Imawano!
Hey! Wait!
Hyo... Now it is your time! Go! Exterminate those idiots who have opposed me!
I won't. I will not be a puppet in your lame little scheme anymore.
What!? You... How did you release yourself from my control!?
Heh... You don't have a clue, do you? Fool, I've never been affected by your pathetic mind control! It never worked on me!
I was trying to judge if you are worthy of your ambition but... I don't think it's necessary anymore. You weak and pathetic little fool!
How dare you Hyo! It was foolish for me to try to use you! And now I shall fix that mistake!
No matter what it takes!!
Gyaaaaahhhhhhhh!!
Was that... a scream!? It came from this way!
This is Justice High... I remember what we did here a year ago...
But why is it so quiet? I feel as if no one is around...
!! What?! This is terrible... How could anyone do this!?
I can sense an incredibly evil energy... It's here! It's different from Hyo Imawano, but I can't get a fix on it!
Gh... ghghgh... ghwoooooooohhhh!!!
WHAT IS THAT?!
Hey freaky boy! Hyo! What's the matter with you?!
Look at that sword! Something seems to be gushing out of it! It could be the source of all the evil energy!
Do you have any idea what it is...!?
I have no idea! I only know that Hyo won't allow us to leave anymore!
It would be disastrous if that evil energy is unleashed upon the world!
We must bring this possessed man back to his true self!
Hmm... who on earth would have attacked president Imawano?
The person had to be very skillful in order to harm the president that badly. That is our only clue as to determining who it was...
Hey hey, you two there! Are you having a date at this time of the day!?
Uhh... Sorry to bother you, but you two chumps have to fight with us!
You're... Gedo High students! What is this all about!?
... Finish them...
No... This doesn't look good!
Ga ha ha ha ha ha! Let's call it a draw for now!!
Just don't let me catch you around us again! Or else...
...Hideo, did you feel it? Did you feel Daigo's insanity?
Hmm... That's the legendary boss, Daigo Kazama... He looked very different from what I imagined him to be...
That's right... He looked as if he has been possessed by something...
!... Could it be!?
... We need to find it out more...
So, what is this all about?
Here's the deal. The attack on our president and the sudden change of Daigo Kazama's personality. Is this YOUR doing?
I don't want to suspect you, but I will not allow a repeat of last year's tragedy either...
Heh... Raizo was defeated because he was... No because he IS weak. There's no reason to blame me for that.
What are you saying!? How can you talk about your father-in-law like that!?
Hayato! Why are you here?
You are messing with people's minds like you did last time, aren't you!? If you are, I will make you regret it!
... You can talk the talk, but are you prepared to fight!
I already told you that I'm not involved in this. You can either believe me or not...
OK. I believe you.
Whatever...
If that is true. Then who is the one doing this?
Teacher! I saw it! The one who attacked president Raizo was wearing a uniform of {}!
What!? Don't talk such nonsense!
It's not nonsense! I'm the one who was there first. Don't you believe me?
Of course I don't, you idiot! I'll prove that Taiyo High is innocent!
No wait, Hayato! ...Hideo, we must accompany Hayato! Let's go!
#WORDS
So there was a scuffle during the Taiyo-Pacific athletic competition. Hayato, did you try to find out who was behind the altercation?
That's right. I can't leave it to my students, you know...
Mmm? What's that? ...Hey you, what happened?
Batsu and his friends had some fight with these unknown girl students!
What!?
Those idiots! And where are those girl students now!?
...There! So you are the ones who got into a fight inside Taiyo High, aren't you!?
That's not true! It was a simple misunderstanding...
You teachers never listen to us and only judge us!
This is none of your business! Beat it before you get hurt!
That is not how one should speak to their elders! Watch your mouth!
What!? Are you saying there's someone who disguises himself as Batsu!?
That seems to be the most natural conclusion. But... we must find a way to distinguish the true Batsu from the fake one.
And until that is done, Batsu will have to take all the blame...
So both Daigo and Batsu are in trouble... This is abnormal.
So you've seen my brother!? Where was he? Please tell me!
He disappeared immediately. I don't think he is still there in the same spot.
If you look for a place where Gedo High students like to hang out, he might be there...
OK then, I'll find someone from Gedo High and find out what order he has given. That's easy! Let's go!
Wait! You can't do that with those wounds! ...I'll patch them up for you. You teachers continue your investigation...
If you say so... I understand. Take care Kyoko.
I can never understand this. Your school president has been attacked and an incident happened during the Taiyo-Pacific athletic competition...
And the sudden personality change of Daigo Kazama, AND then the fake Batsu appeared.
It can't be just a coincidence. This smells wrong.
So you think all of the events are related to each other?
Teacher Hayato! Here you are! Please come with me now!
Batsu! (...Is this the true Batsu? Or...)
Huh? ...Who on earth are you?
H... Hayato!? What are you saying?
What's the matter!? Don't you remember my face?
Don't be stupid! I've never seen you before!
Reveal yourself already! You fake!
Hayato... As you suspected, I'm not Batsu Ichimonji. But how did you know?
It's easy! Your eyes are not burning at all! Batsu's eyes burn into the soul of anyone they see!
...Hee hee hee... I never imagined that it would be such a lame reason. How stupid... Hee hee hee...
...Now I can't let you go! How tragic!
So you are the one who has been behind all of the strange events!
No one can interfere with my plan... I'll eliminate anyone who tries to oppose me at any cost!
By the way, do you have any idea where Kyoko Minazuki is? Shouldn't she be back by now? Hee hee hee...
What do you mean... No! It can't be!
I guess we'll be seeing you again soon! I for one, am looking forward to it!
So you are here! ...I can't believe this! You're truly distasteful!
This is cruel! Kyoko! Kyoko!
Hee hee hee... If you don't want to see her harmed, be nice and let me finish you off quickly!
You... You are truly demented!
... OK I'll take care of this! Hideo, you go and save her. Make sure you don't goof, OK?
Thanks! I'll be back soon so hold on until I can return!
Are you OK Kyoko!? Hayato, it's taken care of now! She's fine!
You don't fight as well as you fake! It's time that you showed us who you really are!
Hee hee hee... Since you amuse me so much, I will allow you to know the truth!
What... You're Kirishima!? Kurow Kirishima! How come you...
How come an elite student of Justice High like yourself would dare to be involved in this!?
Hee hee hee... You fools! Don't you understand?! It's all for my true goal! This merely serves as the first step!
We "{}" wanted to use {} as a cover-up but to achieve that goal, Raizo Imawano and Hyo had to be removed...
So you attacked our president Raizo!?
Sooner or later, all Imawano family members have to be disposed because they will surely stand in my way in the future!
And you all must be disposed as well! You would have been safe if you remained to be spectators just like the other teachers! You're all fools!
What are you bubbling about!? Fight like a man! Come on!
Your simplicity... I hate it! I shall make you regret it!
#WORDS
#WORDS
I never would have suspected that this big hidden organization could have been established inside our school...
We're partially responsible for this since we've never noticed his secret ambition... We're supposed to be good teachers!
It's heartbreaking to see a man collapses in the middle of his dream. Although... It fits you well, Kurow.
Hyo Imawano... This can't be! I thought you had surrendered to my magic!! How come...?
Hah! You're a fool to believe you could control me with that weak magic! You're pathetic!
You should also know you only successfully controlled Daigo Kazama because of the "scar" that I gave him before!
No... It can't be true! How come?!
So... Are you ready to die, Kurow Kirishima!?
Hey, hold it right there! I won't let you guys do that foolish stuff in front of me!
He will be judged by the law! I won't allow unnecessary violence!
FOOLS! This man is an assassin sent by the organization to dispose of me! I won't let him escape!
You... So you knew about it and you let it happen... On purpose! You'll pay for this! Feel my pain!
Gyaaaaahhhhhhhh!!
What happened!? What's going on!?
What was that scream... Kurow!! Who did this to him?
Hyo has disappeared! Could this be his doing? If so, I can't let him go!
Gh... ghghgh... ghwoooooooohhhh!!!
Hyo! What... What happened to him?
This is... Beyond human ability! It looks as if he is possessed by something!
Whatever it is, we must stop him! Give me a hand, you two!
Wait a minute! He looks completely insane! We don't even know if he can recover his true self!
We may end up losing our lives in vain. Is it really worth it?
I won't abandon him.
Because we are his teachers! Teachers are worthless if they abandon their own students!
So I guess I am not the only crazy teacher after all...
Alright! Let's do it!
Help! Please help!! A weird guy is chasing me!!
What?! OK, stay there! I'll help you!
Hey wait a minute, Shoma! A weird guy? ...It's Batsu.
Out of my way! Or you'll get hurt!
Hey, what's the matter with you, Batsu?
Yeah. Try to calm down and tell me what's going on!
Step aside, Roberto and Natsu! I won't tolerate a bully. Even if it is you, Batsu!
How dare you stand against me! I'll make you pay for this!
What did you say?! Hey! Wait up, you creep!
No! Please don't leave me!
Huh?!!
Waaaaaaaa!!!
...I have no idea why he attacked me...
I see... And why are you clinging to Shoma like that?
That's none of your business. Besides, Shoma seems to be very happy this way. Right, Shoma?
What? Well... Um... Yeah... Ha ha ha ha ha ha...
Oh no...
...Why Natsu, are you jealous?
What?! Why would I be jealous?!
Hey, lighten up, Natsu! She's just a little girl. Don't be so serious!
No! I'm not a little girl anymore! Can't you see?
O...Oh, is that right? ...Anyway, don't stay so close to me...
I can't believe this! Shoma, all you care about is that little girl and you won't listen to me at all!
What are you talking about? You're so childish!
Hey you two, calm down! This is stupid!
...You're so stubborn!!
Ha!! You're the stubborn one!
...Look, there's no point in continuing talking like this!
I'll go and investigate why this little girl was attacked by myself. I don't need your help!
...Do whatever you like! Go wherever you like with that little baby!!
H... Hey! Wait, Natsu! W... Wait...
Wow! Now you are mine, Shoma! But... will she be OK?
...Yeah. Don't worry about her. Everything's fine...
...you fool...
We have to find out why Batsu was chasing you.
Thank you. You're so kind...
Don't mention it... Hey, don't stay so close to me! Let's head to Taiyo High!
...There they are! Hey you two! Is Batsu with you?!
Shoma? ...What do you want with Batsu?
That Batsu person has been stalking me.
And finally he chased me and tried to attack me... I was so scared.
I said not to stay so close to me! Anyway... That's why we're looking for Batsu. Where is he now?!
...That's what I want to know! But you know Batsu would never do such things!
It must be some kind of mistake. Besides... are you sure it was Batsu that's been chasing you?
...OK, I understand... You won't believe me, no matter what I say... That's alright...
Hey! Don't cling to me!
Wait... You guys aren't trying to cover for Batsu, are you?!
Hey! You should be ashamed of yourself for suspecting your own friend!
Chairperson? Why are you here?
That scuffle at the Taiyo-Pacific athletic competition and then suspicious happenings at Gedo high... ...I'm very concerned...
This is the time for us to come together and cooperate with each other, not break apart! Shame on you!
Tell Batsu that I won't forgive him!
Hey, wait up, Shoma!
Shoma, you're so cool!
...And you're so simple-minded too. That makes things so much easier for me.
As for you guys, stop snooping around. You'll just make trouble.
What does that mean?
I don't know. Did I say something? Shoma, please wait for me!
...She's taking way too long! How much longer do I have to wait?! She said she'd be back soon...
Shoma...!! Owww... It hurts...
Wha...! What happened?! Were you attacked again?!
Yes... It was a tall foreign guy and a girl with a camera...
What?... No, it can't be... not them... Where did they go?!
We've found you! You know why we are here!!
Shoma... I did nothing wrong... yet these people suddenly attacked me...
Hey wait a minute! You're the one who started a quarrel!
Yeah! Have you forgotten what you just did?!
So you're Batsu's accomplices! Why would you do this?! You're all crazy!!
...Alright. I've fought with most of the major schools now. Time to go back.
Go back? What does that mean?
I truly appreciate your help, Shoma. You've been acting exactly as I expected you to.
However, there's no more reason for me to stay with you, Shoma. Time to say good bye.
Wait a minute! What does that...ghh!!
Good night, Shoma! Have a nice nap and try to forget about me...
Ghh... W... Why...
...Oh you've finally regained consciousness!
Being so simple-minded requires a lot of energy, I guess...
That little girl had already run away...
That girl has something to do with whoever's behind all this. She sneaked into Gorin High for some unknown reason.
Why... she looked so innocent...
Hey! Wake up, already!
Listen! Think of how many friends you've hurt because you believed that girl!
...Natsu... Roberto... What a fool I have been...
...I must see her again... I must find out the truth...
Hey... Wait Natsu! What's the matter? This is not like you!
Shut up! Leave me alone!
What's all the fuss about?
Nagare! You've come just in time. Please help me try to talk some sense into Natsu.
It's Shoma you should be trying to talk to! I did nothing wrong!
...Here you are... Gorin... High...
We've been looking for you, Gorin High students! Are you ready for some serious pain?!
Oh, great! As if I don't have enough trouble already! Now these guys show up!
...so they had a quarrel and parted.
I see...
Shoma is an idiot to be attracted to that little girl! I bet she's just using him!
...Well... Then... We should go to Taiyo High...
...If we see Batsu and his friends... Maybe we'll find some clue...
That sounds like a good idea... Hey Natsu! Where are you going?! You shouldn't act alone!!
...Well... I see you are having a hard time with her...
Hey! Look! Over there... It's Batsu and that girl, Momo!
I'm telling you not to sniff around like that! You're causing me a lot of trouble!
I don't want to be scolded by our boss. I hate that. So stop sticking your nose in where it doesn't belong.
That's not the answer I'm looking for! What are you up to? Tell me!!
Here you are! I've been looking for you! Where's Shoma? Tell me!
Noooo! How come you're here?! You know, guys don't find jealousy very attractive.
...I see... This is more complicated than I thought...
...Alright! Since the whole cast is here, ...Why don't I take on all of you at once!
Everybody, be on guard!
I wanted to defeat all of you but... if I do that, Kurow will scold me.
...Kurow...?
Well, let's call it a day, shall we? See you all, soon. Ciao!!
Hey wait! Tell me where Shoma is!
Wait Natsu! Batsu, I have one question for you. Have you ever attacked that girl?
What?! Batsu attacked that little girl?!
Hey, is that supposed to be some kind of joke? Why would I be such a bully?
...Okey then... who was the Batsu that you met?
I don't care who it was! We must chase her now or we won't see her again!
Impressive... You are scared but yet you have come all the way here!
Batsu...? No you're the fake Batsu who attacked us! You can't fool us again!
I don't know why you pretended to be Batsu, but it's time for you to show us who you really are!
Hee hee hee... Behold! My true self! Don't ever forget it!!
My name is Kurow Kirishima! And we are from {}!!
Our purpose is to exterminate the impotent Imawano family and rule Japan the way it was meant to be!
And for that we had to remove people like you, who are bound by a strong bond of friendship.
So I had Momo sneak into your group and cause confusion and distrust!
Hee hee hee... It seems my plan went well. He behaved exactly as I expected him to!
I'm talking about you, Shoma Sawamura!
Shoma!!
Is that... true? Was that... your plan all along...? Tell me!!
You know I have no choice but to obey Kurow's order. I told you to forget about me...
Hee hee hee... Momo! It's your job to finish Shoma! I'm sure he would appreciate it, too!
...I understand. You hear that, Shoma? Get ready!
You... Did you really...
Hey Shoma! Be yourself! Behave like a man!!
Where did that you go?! The Shoma that I know is carefree and loose and...
It's not too late... You can still save yourself...
That's right! Let's show them how strong our bond is!
Thank you all... Alright! We're going to stop that scum, I promise! Here we go!
#WORDS
column3: the Darkside Student Congress of Justice High

column2: Natsu, Roberto... Nagare... I don't know what to say...
You... fool! You worried us so much...
Well well... It was very like yourself, after all.
...You're fine... That's all I care about...
Kurow... Hang in there... Are you OK...?
Curse you... How come I... This is impossible! How could I lose to such an insignificant fool?!
Hee hee hee... That's right! I'm talking about you, Momo! It's all your fault!!
How could you be so cruel and say such things, Kurow?! (sobbing) ...How could you...
Hey you! How dare you say that to her?!
Are you even human? No person would ever deliberately be so mean! Is your blood red or what?
Shut up! Shut your dirty mouth up!!
Now the only path left for you to take is a one way trip to the other world! You shall suffer for trying to go against me!
No, Kurow! Where are you going?!
This is not good! Let's follow him! We can't let him get away now!
Justice High... For some reason, I feel the atmosphere of this place has become darker than before... Is it just me?
This could be another doing of that Kurow person. Where did he go?!
Kurow... Where are you?! Please answer me!
Gyaaaaahhhhhhhh!!
What was that scream?! ...It came from that direction!!
Kurow!!
This is... so cruel... What happened here...?
Ghh! I never expected the curse sealed in Hyo Imawano was this powerful...
...Hee hee hee hee hee!! Go destroyer! Rule the world with terror on behalf of me!
Hyo Imawano. No, he is different... His atmosphere is terrible!!
...! Oh no! Get down!!
Kurow! Wake up please!
That was close! ...You idiot!! Be more cautious!
Shoma... But I'm worried about Kurow...
Listen! Until that Hyo is defeated, we can't save him!
So Momo, will you lend us your power?
...Shoma, you got it!
I do not blame you Momo! I just got carried away. Besides... It was kind of fun!
I'm reluctant but have to welcome you in this emergency! We need your help!
When it comes to team work, Gorin High never loses!
...It's good to have friends...
Alright... Let's do it everyone!
...So you've come to ask me for help... Is that right?
Your real name may be Aoi Himezaki, but people call you Zaki. I've heard a lot about you. Can you please help us?
I'm not talking to you! Hey, you there! I know this is your problem. Why don't you ask me yourself!?
That's true... I'm sorry. Let me ask you now. Please help us...
Hmmm... I can't decide until I test you. Show me what you've got!
... How was that? Am I qualified!?
Hmm... You're indeed a sister of Daigo Kazama. I was impressed.
WHAT?! How did you know that?! I've been trying so hard to keep that a secret...
Ha ha... Now you see why I asked Zaki for help.
OK, let's go! Sooner is always better.
Yes... Thank you very much!
It was all for nothing. We went all the way to {} but Daigo was absent...
Besides that, there were very few students there. I didn't see Edge or Gan either. My brother could be with them...
Now that I think about it, I've often seen Gedo High students around here.
It is possible Gedo High students are up to something as a whole...?
Daigo... Where are you and what are you doing now...?
Akira! You're here! I've been looking for you!
Oh Batsu! You've been looking for me for what?
For what? Well... It was for...
THIS!!!
Wha... Batsu! What do you think you're doing!?
Hey you... you have a serious problem. How dare you punched a woman out of blue!? What's your problem!?
I don't need to answer you! Your mere existence annoys me! That's it! I'm going to take you down NOW!!
#WORDS
That's it for today! You should thank me for having not taken your lives!!
Shoot! He's disappeared already!!
It seems Batsu has gone crazy as well... What has happened to my friends?
Akira... Thinking about it won't help. We must act...
Let's head to Taiyo High. But keep in mind that depending on why they attacked us, things may get rough.
I'll settle this! I won't stop until they apologize to us!!
Akira and her group met with Batsu at {} and questioned him fiercely...
Batsu insisted on his innocence. They fought to verify his words and realized that there had to be a 'fake' Batsu appearing around the area...
Who on earth is using Batsu's name and for what reason?
I have a bad feeling about this... But I bet that this might have something to do with Daigo's sudden personality change...
Shhh! Someone is coming. They appear to want to talk to us...
So it was you! You're the ones who had an incident at Taiyo High!!
But that was necessary to clear up our misunderstanding...
You teachers are always the same! You never try to listen to us and only judge us!
This is none of your business! Get lost before you get hurt!
That is not a good way to speak to your elders! Behave yourself!
#WORDS
What!? Are you saying someone is disguising himself as Batsu!?
That seems to be the most natural conclusion. But it is difficult to distinguish the real Batsu from the fake one.
Unless we find a solution for that, we can't stop people blame the real Batsu for all the evil doings.
First it was Daigo, and now it's Batsu... This appears to be a real problem.
So you've seen my brother!? Where was he? Please tell me!
He disappeared immediately. I don't think he is still there in the same spot.
If you look for a place where Gedo High students like to hang out, he might be there...
OK then, I'll find someone from Gedo High and find out what order he has given. That's easy! Let's go!
Wait! You can't do that with that wound! Let me help to heal you first. You teachers continue your investigation, OK?
OK... I should be the last one to be taken care of...
Oh Zaki! You must hurry!
What's the matter!? Any problem!?
It's Gedo High... They suddenly began attacking our school Seijyun High!
We manage to protect our school as a team right now. But I don't know how long it will last...
Shoot... I won't let them mess up our school like this! Let's go Akira!!
Hey wait! Yurika still hasn't shown up yet...
What is this all about!? It looks we're going to have a war!
Everyone! Our Zaki has finally arrived!!
My dear people... I apologize for causing you a lot of trouble! Don't worry, everything will be alright from now on!
Brother! Can't you hear me!? Please wake up and restore your true self!
... A... Akira... Gh... Gwoooooohhhh!!!
Wait Akira! You shouldn't be talking to him now! We must stop him by force!
...This is... Whistle noise... Where is it coming from...?
Guwooooooooohhhh...
...Ugh... Akira? Edge... Gan...
Great! Now you're back to normal brother!
Yeah... Your serious fists have released me from the curse...
I still have some memory of what I did while being mind-controlled. I'm sorry to have caused you so much trouble.
Who could have done this to our boss!? We must find out!
Don't be so hasty! We'll settle this Gedo High style! We'll head to HIM!
By the way... Has Yurika shown up yet, Akira?
...! No it can't be! But...
Guwooohhhh! ...Guwaaahhhhhhhhhhh!!
Daigo!? Wait! Where are you going!?
No! This doesn't look good! Hurry! We must chase him!
... Akira...
Hey... Where have you been? You took way too long to just have your wound taken care of.
... I know a shortcut... This way... Follow me...
Yurika... You...
Taking advantage of the 'scar' Hyo Imawano caused before, he successfully cast a spell on me...
Under his control, I conquered schools one after another in an attempt to cut the ties between them...
It worked and everyone became suspicious about everything and then they all ended up fighting against each other... For no real reason!
I bet they had planned to execute some evil plan during the confusion. They simply used me and Gedo High as a tool!
Then why don't we ask about the 'plan' to the person in charge directly? Hey! I know you're there! Come out!!
I don't get it. Why do small fish always try to flock together? Hee hee hee... I just don't get it!
Batsu! ...No you can't fool us anymore! You're the fake! Show us your true self already!!
Hee hee hee... You want it, you got it GIRL!
My name is Kurow Kirishima! And we're from {}!!
Yurika! ...This is some kind of joke, right? Why... Why are you there!?
Hee hee hee... It can't be helped. No one can deny the fact this impotent woman is my sister!
What!? You're sister and brother!? So you've been cheating us from the beginning!?
Akira, Zaki... I'm sorry. I have no excuse.
It seems you've become too intimate with your target... Your existence only disgraces my honor.
If you don't follow me, I'll turn you into my silent servant... Just like Daigo!
Kurow... I... I...
Hee hee hee... Daigo Kazama! You didn't think you were really free from my control, did you?
You can never escape from my binding whistle! Come back as my servant and work for me!
Gh...? Guwoooooo...
Ghhhh... Humph!
N... No! This can't be!! How come my spell doesn't work...? My whistle spell must work!!
It's only natural! Now we're with him! You won't be able to control him as you wish anymore!
You'll never understand that this 'incredible power' is all you ever need to be strong!
Shut up, you fools! You will suffer!!
#WORDS
column3: Darkside Student Congress of Justice High

column2: It's all over now...
Th... This can't be! My plan cannot end like this... I'll take each one of you to your doom!
Hey Kurow! No, come back!!
Yurika, wait! You can't go alone!!
Oh no! These people are causing me too much trouble!
I've never expected to enter Justice High again...
It's weird... I see no sign of life around here... The atmosphere of this place has become a lot darker than a year ago...
Gyaaaaahhhhhhhh!!
!! What was that scream!?
Could it be Yurika's!? Let's go!
Yurika!! Are you OK!?
Yes I'm fine but... Kurow isn't!
This is terrible. He is barely breathing. This is inhuman!
You fool... He tried to match the awesome power of Hyo Imawano. He pushed it too far...
Yurika, get a grip! Is this Hyo Imawano's doing!?
!! This atmosphere! Who is it!?
You're Hyo Imawano, aren't you!? Are you trying to dispose of us too?
No he's not! This is not Hyo Imawano!!
Gh... ghghgh... ghwoooooooohhhh!!!
Wha... What's happening!?
Kurow must have released the evil spirit that has been sealed inside Hyo Imawano's sword. It will destroy everything...
That fool! It's like a kid who would do reckless things if he can't have his way!
I can't watch my dear people get hurt anymore! I'll put an end to all this!
...Are you sure Daigo can be in a place like this...?
Yes... We'll also see the person who has been disguising himself as Batsu here.
How do you know that?
...We'll see. Right, Kurow?
Who is it!? Who's there!?
You called my real name. That must mean you've betrayed me! You betrayed your own brother, Yurika!!
!! ...Your brother!? Is that true? Tell me Yurika!
It is true. Kurow Kirishima is my brother. And he is the mastermind behind all the recent happenings!
Hee hee hee... I may be the mastermind but you're my accomplice. Don't talk about it as if you're not involved!
Kurow... I didn't have enough courage to stop you. I hoped you would realize...
But I now know it was my big mistake! Kurow! You're wrong!
As your sister, I'll stop you even if I must sacrifice my life!
Hee hee hee... Yurika. You said that with such strength! I am very impressed. Especially considering your timid personality. However...
you're now worthless to me! With the power of my spell, I'll transform you into my loyal servant!
Wait! I won't let you have things your way, you selfish idiot!
You have no respect for blood relation! That... is a mistake!
This is simply ridiculous! I'll send all three of you to your doom!
Shoot! He escaped again! I'm embarrassed!!
Brother! Brother Daigo!!
...He will be OK. He is asleep but has been released from Kurow's spell. He'll recover soon.
I'm leaving now... He's my brother. His fault is mine. I'm sorry that I deceived you...
Hmph! What are you saying now!? Do you expect Akira to say "That's OK. Never mind."?
Don't mention it, Yurika. I still remember you were so kind to me when I was first transferred to {}.
Besides we're friends, right? Let's go all of us three together! We must put an end to this uproar!
Akira...
You're indeed the sister of our big boss... Here you go, Akira! You'll need this.
We'll take the big boss to a safe place! That helmet should protect you on behalf of us!
Thank you, you two! Please take good care of my brother Daigo!
#WORDS
Kurow... entered {} because he was ordered to exterminate the Imawano family by a certain organization.
Imawano family... That's Batsu and Kyosuke!!
And Kurow tried to use the situation. He wanted to rule Japan. That was something that Hyo Imawano failed to accomplish.
So he attacked the problematic students so that they would not cooperate with each other. He also used Gedo High as his tool.
...And I myself followed Kurow's order and took superior students to him so they could work for Kurow. I couldn't stop him...
Silence! We'll talk later. ...There's someone there!!
!! Kurow! Kurow!
This is terrible... Who could have done this!?
Hyo Imawano... Could this be your doing? How many mistakes do you have to make!?
Wait Akira! Things look really wrong with him!!
No way... Could 'that' be... awakened!?
Yurika, what do you mean?
My brother once told me... That an incredibly evil spirit is sealed inside Hyo's sword.
Kurow must have released it!
Gh... ghghgh... ghwoooooooohhhh!!!
No... It would be disastrous if it gets out of this building. We must keep him inside! Please, we've got to try!
#WORDS
Hey, check it out! Aren't those Justice High teachers over there?
What are we gonna do, boss? Should we take care of them before they mess up our plan?
This will be a nice start to our party. Do it!
Ha ha ha! Alright, boss! Hey you two, yeah, you! Are you having a date at this time of a day!?
Sorry, but now you're gonna have to fight us!
You...you are Gedo High students. Why do you want to start a confrontation with us?
...Do it...
Oh no... This doesn't look good!
Ga ha ha ha ha ha! Well, that's enough exercise for today, ha ha ha!
And another thing... You better stop snooping around, or next time we won't be pulling our punches!
What's our next target, boss?
...Those rats sniffing around us...
Huh? Oh that must be our target! Good. They haven't noticed us yet... This is going to be cool...
When it comes to chaos, Gedo High is the first school that comes to my mind. Let's go there and see what information we can gather!
You shouldn't automatically cast suspicion just based on reputation. You should be more open-minded, or you'll miss the truth.
Ha! It's too late for that! You shouldn't have accused us without proof!
This, makes me mad! What are we gonna do about it, boss?
Get them!
Ha ha ha ha ha! Man, that was pathetic! You call that fighting? You guys suck!!
Stop snooping around or we won't be so nice next time! Remember that, losers!
You are definitely our leader, boss! I can't help pulling my punches against women and kids, but you didn't. That was amazing!
Huh? Oh, our boss is over there. What's he doing in a place like this?
Looks like he's with somebody... Wait... Who is that?
...so I need you to crush either one of those Gorin High students. Got that?
...I got it, madam...
Good. Oh, and say hello to the broom-headed geek who's eavesdropping over there.
W... What did she just call me?! Boss! Who was that little girl?!
Let's go... Our target is Gorin high...
Boss?
We don't have time to deal with these morons right now...! Shoma... What happened to you... where are you?
I'm wondering the same thing! Boss, have you been getting your instructions from that little girl?
...Let's go...
Boss!!
Man, this is weird... Edge... What happened to our boss?
Gan, I think something ain't right with our boss.
I know what you mean, dude, it's whacked!
There's no way our boss would take orders from a little girl, not the Daigo I know!
Something must have happened to him while he was on his training trip!
Mmm... Maybe we'd better let Akira know about this.
Edge! There was an order to gather all {} students! Our target is {}!
What?! That's where Akira was transferred to! This doesn't look good! We gotta do something!
What's this... Are they trying to start a war or what?!
This isn't a joke... Where's our boss?!
Over there! Looks like Akira is with him.
Brother! Can't you hear me?! Snap out of it!
... A... Akira... Gh... Gwoooooohhhh!!!
Wait Akira! He won't listen to us right now! We'll have to take him by force!
#WORDS
Ahh... Oh, Akira? And Edge and Gan...
Finally, you're yourself again, brother!
I guess so. The strength of your punches must have released me from the mind control spell...
I still have some memory of what I have done while being controlled. I've given you a lot of trouble, I'm sorry.
Mind control?! Is this Hyo Imawano's doing again?!
It's those Justice High students again, those arrogant little creeps!
No, it isn't Hyo this time... But the truth can still be found at {}!
#WORDS
Guwooh! ...Guwaaaahhhhhhh!!
Brother?! Wait! Where are you going?!
This looks bad! ...Gan, Akira! We'll follow him! Come on!
The guy who cast a spell on me... It seems his purpose was to create distrust among our schools using Gedo High as his tool.
What was that little girl doing?
She was just a messenger. The true mastermind who was giving me instructions is... You! Show your face already!
Impressive... you are indeed their boss. It seems you sensed my presence.
Who the heck are you?!
I'm Kurow Kirishima! And we are {}!
Hyo Imawano, whom you know well, failed to rule Japan. But I shall succeed! That is the purpose of the congress!
All we need now are expendables like yourselves. I'm afraid we can't allow you to escape now!
Daigo Kazama! Come back to my hands and devote your life to serving me!
...Guoooooaaaaaahhhhhhhhh!!!
Boss! Is he trying to control our boss again?
...Hey, the whistle! Without his whistle, our boss should be fine!
You can't interfere with Kurow, Mr. Broom-head. Back off!
No more playing games! It's time to finish this... Surrender at once!
Kashiiiii!!
What was that? What happened?!
Now he can't use his spell! Akira, here is your chance! Attack him!
Brother!
Kurow Kirishima! It's time to teach you a lesson!
#WORDS
column3: the Darkside Student Congress of Justice High

column2: Why? What was wrong with my plan? It was perfect! How could it fail?
Hyo Imawano...? ...I have an idea. I'll make him deal with them!
Hyo! I order you to dispose of them with extreme prejudice!
...Sorry, but I choose not to!
What?! But you can't!
You thought you had control over me but I was actually pretending. Kurow Kirishima, you've pushed it too far and have sealed your doom!
Wha... What...?
There's no place for you to go! My sword is upon you!
...No way... This can't be happening! I can never be killed by you!!
Gyaaaaahhhhhhhh!!
Where did he go?! ...Waahh! What is this?!
This is too cruel... Hyo Imawano, is this your doing?
Something is wrong with him. He looks... different...
Gh... ghghgh... ghwoooooooohhhh!!!
Ooops! Something looks terribly wrong with this guy! What should we do, boss?
Akira, take Kurow and the rest of these guys and evacuate the school. I have an old score to settle...
Brother... I understand. Just remember I'll be waiting for you, so you better come back!
Boss! Just so you know, I'm with you no matter what happens! Don't even try to stop me!
Gedo High students never listen to others! Count me in! It's time to flex some muscle!
I see you've gradually become true men! I won't try to stop you! Come with me, my friends, as we fight to the end!!
Hey! I know you're there! Show yourself already, you mind-controlling freak!
Well, well... I wasn't going to waste my time on someone as inferior as you, but...
Eiji Yamada, Gan Isurugi, Aoi Himezaki and Akira Kazama! You've learned too much about my plan! Now I shall have to dispose of you.
It is most unfortunate... Losing 4 tools at a time is such a bother. You caused me a lot of trouble!
Get a load of this guy! Do you ever stop thinking about yourself?! We're never going to cooperate with you!
Oh please... Don't make threats you can't live up to, weakling! You can't even fight without someone else's help!
You...! You called me by my real name! I'll make you pay for that! NOBODY calls me by my real name!!!!
Hee hee hee... You are so dashing! But can you say the same for this guy?
Come on, Daigo Kazama! Show your foolish friends how powerful you truly are!
Hey! No fair, running away! Wait up!
Hee hee hee... {} has lost their unity again and Akira Kazama has lost her mental support. And it was your own fault!
It was painful for me to have lost Daigo Kazama, but it was not in vain. And I am insulted you thought I was running away!
If you think you can't handle anymore tragedy, then never, ever try to interfere with my plans again! Hee hee hee... Excuse me now!
Wait! Hey don't go!
Brother! Brother?! Please wake up!
Pleeeeeease!
Akira... I'm sorry...
...That idiot! He seriously ticked me off!
I swear I will have my revenge... Kurow! You'll pay for this! I'll chase you to the end of the world!
#WORDS
This is terrible... Why...
I can't believe it! What were those guys at Pacific High thinking!?
Hmm... We should pay a visit to Boman. He may know something.
Greetings, Batsu Ichimonji and Kyosuke Kagami.
What? Who the heck are you?! How do you know our names?!
Hee hee hee...Confused, are you? Well, perhaps your friend, Daigo Kazama can help!
What? Daigo? What are you doing here? Is something wrong?
Gh... gwoooooooooaaa!!
Hee hee hee...Is that the best you can do? I expected more from the Imawano family. How truly disappointing!
Shut up! Who on earth are you?!
Now now, no need to be hasty. I'm sure we'll be seeing more of each other ... assuming you survive that long.
Wait! ...What was all that about? And why would Daigo turn on us like that?
Something is seriously wrong with that guy. I got a really bad vibe from him. I don't think he's kidding around.
First the Pacific High incident, now this. What will happen next?
(...his aura...it's...No it can't be...)
...So you're saying that someone deliberately made that scuffle happen, and you had nothing to do with it?
The mysterious man you just saw... he must be involved somehow. I'll go look for him and prove we are innocent!
OK we'll have to cooperate with them. In the meantime, let's conduct a different investigation and see what facts we can uncover for ourselves.
Wait a minute! I need to talk to you!
Huh? Oh Akira! You're not going to believe this but your brother just...
Enough! Don't talk anymore!
Akira, what's the matter?
Batsu... I thought you were my friend but...
How dare you do that to us?! It's so cowardly to attack a girl without warning!
W... wait! I don't understand! Please, try to calm down!
You can't fool us again! Batsu Ichimonji, I will never forgive you!
Batsu! Are you OK?
Hmph! You disappoint me! Where did your high spirits go?!
You can't be the real Batsu. He's a much better fighter. This is a waste of my time. See ya.
Aw man, this is so embarrassing!
It's not so bad. These things happen.
Save your sympathy for someone else! I won't forgive myself for this!
Hey Batsu!
Had enough? Are you thinking straight now?
That power... I know you are the real Batsu. Then who was that Batsu we just met?
What do you mean by 'real'?
We were just attacked by a guy who looks exactly like him. He never spoke.
We believed it was Batsu, but suddenly he attacked us. He looked very determined.
Looks just like him? Do you have a brother or something, Batsu?
Nope! Not as far as I know.
That means... someone has been disguising himself as Batsu. But who is doing this and why?
Batsu... where did he go?
I don't know... but he needs to figure things out for himself, and we can't help him with that. Let's leave him alone for a while.
Hey you there! Is Batsu with you?!
Shoma, what do you want with Batsu?
That Batsu person has been stalking me!
And just now he chased me and tried to attack me... I was so scared... Oh, Shoma!
OK, ok, I understand! Don't stand so close to me! Anyway... now you know the situation. So, where is he?!
That's what we want to know! But Batsu would never do such things! You know that!
It must be some kind of misunderstanding. Are you sure it was really Batsu who was chasing you?
(Sobbing) Never mind! Just forget it! You won't believe me, no matter what I say...(sob, sob) That's ok...
H... hey! I told you not to cling to me like that!
Mmm... wait. Are you covering for Batsu?
Hey! You should be ashamed of yourself for suspecting your own friend!
Chair person! Why are you here?
That scuffle at the Taiyo-Pacific athletic event and the incident at Gedo High... I'm very concerned.
This is the time for us to cooperate with each other! Yet look at you, arguing foolishly. Shame on you!
Tell Batsu that I won't forgive him for this!
Shoma, wait!
You're so cool, Shoma.
And... you're so gullible. It makes things so much easier.
And as for you guys, quit sniffing around. You'll only make trouble for me.
Huh? What does that mean?
I don't know. Did I say something? I don't remember. Shoma, please wait for me!
Who's that girl...?
What's this? What happened?!
Hayato! Are you alright?! Hang in there!
So, you finally showed up. I was just playing with these guys since I had a lot of time to kill.
Be on guard everyone! That person is not Batsu!
So... you're the imposter!
You deliberately made people suspect Batsu and caused problems among my friends! I won't let you get away with that!
Hee hee hee. See what happens when you try to defy me, you silly little amateurs!
Hinata! Ugh! My body...
However, I can't let you be destroyed yet. I still need you to work. Work for me!
Why would I work for you? You think that just by beating me in a fight you suddenly have total control over me?!
I'm impressed by your boldness, but you really should learn to be more careful with yourself. You can easily be replaced!
Hinata!
Stop it! Let her go!
Ghh... Ahh... Batsu... Batsu...
Batsuuuuuuuuuu!!!
Behold my new special move! Super Guts Bullet!!
What?! But this move is... You......!!
Batsu!!
Sorry to have kept you waiting guys. I'll take it from here!
Hee hee hee... That was too flashy an entrance for a loser like you!
I'm going to personally thank you for making me your scapegoat. ...But where's your buddy Daigo, huh? I doubt you can do anything without his help, faker!
I think you need to be taught a lesson in respect!
...That's all for today. But remember: Our battle has only just begun!
Batsu... Batsu! What took you so long?!
Sorry guys. I was too busy feeling sorry for myself, and I know you had to suffer because of that.
Batsu... You look so different. You must have had really intense training to be able to improve both your body and mind in such a short period.
Batsu...
Teacher... I must apologize to you. I caused you a lot of trouble.
Don't mention it. I'm just embarrassed that you saw me get beaten so badly.
Listen, Batsu. That fake guy is definitely skillful, but that's about it.
There's no reason for you to be afraid of him anymore. I know you can beat him, so what are you waiting for? Go get him!
I'll stay here and take care of Hayato and everyone else's wounds.
I also need to clear up the misunderstanding about you, Batsu!
Thanks, I leave it to you. And now, it's payback time!!!
It's impressive you've come this far! You must be hiding good luck charms.
Now I'll return to my true self. There's no reason to disguise myself as you anymore.
I am Kurow Kirishima! And we are {}!
You! You were there with Daigo when the scuffle happened at the Taiyo-Pacific athletic competition!
I knew it was you... But why did you pretend to be me!?
Hee hee hee... It's all for the extermination of the Imawano family!
What?!
To exterminate you effectively, I thought it was best to isolate you from your friends.
Hee hee hee... And it worked perfectly! You were all so easily fooled. You instantly believed I was the real Batsu.
Why you...!!
Forget it! Raizo Imawano has already been beaten and even Hyo Imawano is now under my control!
Brother!
You have no chance! ...Now Hyo, dispose of these three!
...I decline it.
...What did you just say?! I gave you an order... You must obey!
Don't you know I've just been pretending? Did you really think you could control me?! You are no match for me, you pathetic fool!
No way... That's impossible... How could you be pretending all this time?
...Hyo! I can never let you survive!
It's time to shut up! I'll destroy you and your evil ambitions!
#WORDS
column3: the|Darkside Students' Congress|the Darkside Students' Congress

column2: Hmph! It's a disgrace for the Imawano family that they sent a loser like this as an assassin.
What do you mean by 'they', brother? Wasn't it all his doing?
Hee hee hee... It was those who rule the darkside society that sent me here! You members of the Imawano family had better be wary of them!
They wanted to cut the Imawano family apart from their society. They feel the family has had too much exposure to normal society.
That's so mean! How can that be acceptable to Batsu and Kyosuke?!
Ha ha... That's something I would expect to hear from an imbecile like you.
I'll have those darkside society leaders kneel down before me someday! Until that is achieved, I'll bear with any insult!
But Hyo! You're an exception! You've always stood in my way! Your existence is a nuisance to me!
Idiot! I'll crush you together with your ugly pride!
Gyaaaaahhhhhhhh!!
That scream... Could that be Kurow's?!
Darn! I can't see anything!
My brother's gone! Where did he go?!
This is terrible... Could this be Hyo's doing?!
Brother! You're not the evil person you used to be! Please do not go back to your old ways!
Your atmosphere... You're not the Hyo that I know! Who the heck are you?!
Oh no! It's too late... My brother has finally been awakened!!
Dad! What do you mean by your brother?!
My brother Mugen's long-time sealed energy has finally been released!!
Look! The energy coming out of that broken sword is wrapping around Hyo's body... Hang in there, Hyo!
...Except for his appearance, he is not Hyo Imawano anymore! That's the ghost of Mugen Imawano who is possessed with hatred!
No! Then what's going to happen to Hyo?
I'm sorry but...
Gwoohhh... K... Kyosuke...
Brother! Can you see who I am?!
Gh... Kyosuke... Do not... let the name of Imawano... our father's name... be disgraced... anymore...
...You must stop it Kyosuke!! Stop the foolishness that is being conducted by myself... and our father... while my conscience lasts!!
No! Don't say that brother! You'll be OK!
Kyosuke! What you call "gentleness"... Is that solely emotional!? It shouldn't be!
Hyo... You said that well. I understand! We have to do it, Kyosuke!
Batsu?!
If we don't do it, Hyo's name will forever be remembered as a murderer... Together with his father.
You know how much pain your brother is in, right?!
...Yes, I understand... But I will try to save my brother at any cost! No matter what the odds are!
What is it? You came back alone and now you want to talk? Well, make it quick... I'm busy.
...Just come with me. You'll know.
Very impressive, Yurika. You actually brought them back successfully! Good job for someone as slow as you!
Who are you? What do you want with us?
Well... I just want you to stop snooping around, and mind your own business. You shouldn't worry about things.
What does that mean? I need more explanation.
I'm saying I'll be in trouble if you don't stop your little investigation.
It will be me who gets scolded and I don't like that, so you'd better do as I say!
That's not an explanation. Why would I listen to that?! Tell me what you're up to!
You! I finally found you! Where's Shoma? Tell me!
Why should I?! Did your jealousy bring you here? You know, men find that very unattractive.
...I see... This is more complicated than I thought...
Hmph! ...Fine! Since you're here anyway, I'll deal with all of you at the same time!
I wanted to defeat all of you at once but I would be scolded by Kurow if I did that.
Kurow...?
Let's call it a day, then. See you guys later, bye!
Hey you! Wait! Tell me where Shoma is!
Wait Natsu! Batsu, I want to confirm one thing. Have you ever attacked that girl?
What?! Batsu attacked her?!
What are you talking about?! How could you think I'm such a bully?!
...Then... who was that Batsu you just met?
Could it be that fake Batsu again?!
That's enough! Who on earth could be doing this?!
It doesn't matter who it is! We must chase that little brat now or we'll lose her!
...Natsu looked really upset. She might be in trouble if I let her go alone... Sorry Batsu! I'll try to catch up with you later!
Wait Hinata! You shouldn't go alone!
It's been a long time... Kyosuke.
Brother! You haven't been around recently. What have you been...
Hyo! Why are you suddenly attacking your own brother?! Are you crazy?!
I'm disappointed, Kyosuke. So this is the result of what you call "friendship"!
Wha... No that's not true!
However hard you might struggle, you can never escape the fact that you are part of the Imawano family! If you disgrace our family name, I must kill you!
Brother... I haven't given up for anything. As long as we trust in our friendship, we won't lose to anyone!
Kyosuke has gained a different type of strength than yours. It's not just physical strength, but different nature of strength.
Ha... Your big talk amuses me, amateur...
Your enemies are inside Justice High. But one of your allies seems to be caught in a different place.
What? You mean Hinata?!
I'm going to see the true power of your 'friendship'! Go and save her by yourself!
Brother...?
We must hurry! Search absolutely everywhere!!
Batsu! Kyosuke! Go away! You can't come here! It's dangerous!
I've found you finally... Hold on! I'll save you now!
It won't be so easy. I have my own mission to accomplish.
So you are my fake! You used my face without my permission! Reveal your real self!
You got it. Behold my true identity!
I am Kurow Kirishima! And we are {}!
You! You were there with Daigo when the scuffle happened at the Taiyo-Pacific athletic competition!
I'm afraid it's time for you to die. Hinata Wakaba, you will watch helplessly as I destroy your allies in front of you!

column2: It's time to finish this. Do you wish to say anything before you die?
No... Is this really the end...
Hey! The Batsu that I know would never give up so easily!
That voice... It can't be!
Who is it that tries to interfere with me?! Where are you?
Ha ha ha! What are you looking at? I'm right here!
Roy!!
Don't forget about me, guys! Roy, I've saved Hinata! She's safe now!
Batsu! Kyosuke! Are you OK? I'm sorry for being so hard on you...
Let's talk later. First we must deal with this guy!
Got it! You messed with my life! ...That was a mistake!
Silence, you insolent fool! You are nothing but a toy for me to play with! You have no chance against me!
No it can't be... How come I... Ghh...
Whew... It's done. Thank you for coming, Roy. I thought I was finished.
We flew to Japan as soon as we heard something bad happened at Pacific High. My dad had already briefly informed me about this guy.
Who on earth is he?
He is an assassin who was assigned to exterminate you, the Imawano family.
And to secretly rule the country of Japan.
His plan was to disguise himself as Batsu and cause trouble, creating suspicion amongst all of you. This would result in each member's isolation.
I see... That was the purpose of those 'fake Batsu' incidents...
Hmph... It is unfortunate that he could not handle his ambition.
Brother! Why are you here...
Ghh... Hyo Imawano... My plan would have succeeded if only you hadn't interfered!
Pathetic! You still can't face reality! I'll release you from your suffering once and for all... with my sword!
Gyaaaaahhhhhhhh!!
What happened?! Darn! I can't see anything!
Gwoh...Gwohhhhh!!
Brother! What's the matter?!
No! ...It's Kurow... he's...
Oh no! Hyo has gone too far!
I don't know why he did this but... I can't let him escape! We must go after him!
He's here! This way!!
Brother! Do you know who I am?
Gh... Gwoooooohhhh!!
Hyo is suffering! It looks as if he is fighting with something!
...Kyosuke... Defeat me! Before our father completely awakens! While my conscience lasts...
Father?! What do you mean, brother?
Soon... my body... will be taken over by our father's hateful energy... If that happens, it will be too late!
Stop it, Kyosuke! Stop our father's insanity! We can't let him slaughter... Gwoaaaahhhhhhhhhhh!!!
Hyo!! ...Kyosuke!!
Father... I'll never forgive you!!
Guwoohh!! Who... Who is it...?
Hee hee hee! You've grown old, president Imawano! Are you really the head of the Imawano family? You're too weak!
Uhhh...this is disgraceful...
Hee hee... He fainted. It would be so easy to finish him now but he could be useful in the future...
Do you honestly believe that things will progress as you have planned?
You're... Hyo Imawano?! What exactly is your question supposed to mean?
If you think your ambition is strong enough then just go for it! But don't underestimate the power of their friendship!
Hee hee hee... I never expected advice from an inferior being such as you. You need to worry about yourself, not me!
Hee hee hee... Weakling! Is this really Hyo Imawano, the strongest member of the Imawano family? You disappoint me!
...But what was that ominous energy I could sometimes feel from him? It seemed to have the strength of a beast.
Gh... Guwoooohhhh...
Wha... What's this!? What is this strange Force? It can't be coming from Hyo, can it?
Hee hee hee... I see. There's some evil energy hidden within Hyo Imawano...
OK, then I'll take control of you before you can start wielding that evil power!
Hyo Imawano! You are going to be reborn as my loyal soldier!
The Taiyo-Pacific athletic competition... An event planned to enhance friendship between Japan and the US... What nonsense!
Hee hee hee... What if that friendship gets shattered by their own students!?
Go! My loyal soldiers of Pacific High! Go and destroy Taiyo High!!
...Kurow! I've found a couple of excellent candidates. Come over here!
Hi Batsu! Believe me, I have no idea why this scuffle happened... Wha?! Oof...
Batsu? What do you think you're doing... Aaah!!
Hee hee hee... I guess my disguis good since you didn't even notice!
Disguise?! ...Who on earth are you then?!
Hee hee hee... If you want to know, I'll tell you! Remember this well:
My name is Kurow Kirishima! You are going to help me to take over the world!!
It's over. Now we'll go back to our headquarters and do some work.
The next step in my plan is almost complete! We will create three excellent soldiers. Don't you agree, Yurika?
... Yeah... I guess so...
What's your problem, Yurika? Aren't you happy? ...By the way Kurow, where are we going next?
Yurika! Make contact with Kyoko Minazuki. We'll use her as bait to lure all of the teachers and then defeat them!
I'll leave the details up to you! Now go! And remember: do not fail me!
Kurow...
There... I've taken care of your wounds. Try to be more careful next time, OK? What was your name again?
Yurika. Yurika... Kirishima.
Kirishima...? I've heard that name before... Ugh!
Y... You...
I want you to stop snooping around. I want you to stop now!
Don't be so ridiculous! What are you up to?!
Hee hee hee... nothing. Oh! Did I tell you I invited Kyoko Minazuki to our place?
What... Kyoko?! Why did you do that?!
I think you know why! If you care about her, then I suggest you let me defeat you!
Kirishima...? Why did you...
You don't need to know that. All you should care about is making sure you do what I tell you to do. You work for me now.
Don't worry, Hideo. I'll let you work for me together with Kyoko Minazuki... as my loyal servants!
Gh... Ghwaaaaahhhhh!
Hee hee... Now Justice High has been taken over by the {}. Our next goal will be...
Kurow, I need to talk with you...

Why did you bring me here? Did you find another excellent soldier?
Yurika! Is that the mastermind behind all of this?
You're brave to step into our school. Now, release Daigo!
...I see. Yurika, it seems you have betrayed me!
Kurow... I can't let you go on like this. I'll do whatever it takes to stop you!
Are you sure you're capable? You just follow others blindly, like sheep!
But perhaps...If you try with all your might, then maybe you will be able to defeat me!
Yurika... Hang on... Yurika...
How was that? This is what you asked for. Are you satisfied now?
Aww, poor Yurika. Oh well, once a loser, always a loser!
Kurow... I...
You needn't worry! There's absolutely zero reason for me to use you anymore!!
Rest well for now... until I have you reborn...
Hinata! What do you think you're doing?!
Welcome, Batsu Ichimonji and Kyosuke Kagami!
You've been targeting us from the beginning, haven't you?!
Very perceptive. But to be more precise, my target is actually the Imawano family!
Raizo Imawano has already fallen and Hyo is under my total control! You two are the only ones left to be defeated!!
Why are you doing this? What have they ever done to you?!
Even if you beat us, my friends will surely defeat you! Evil guys can never succeed in the end!
Most of the friends you trust have already fallen under my spell. Now it's your turn!
Batsu! Kyosuke!! Wake up... Please!!
Stop it! That's useless. Do you not even known how to take care of your wounded friends?
You have no right to speak to me! This is beyond cruel... You've gone too far!
Kurow, she's so bitter, isn't she? Why don't you punish her?
Obviously she hates me because I am so powerful. But it doesn't matter. I'm not looking for friendship, they are merely puppets for me to control!
Hee hee hee... Hinata Wakaba. Come to me and use your power to do my bidding!
N... Noooooooooooooo!!!
Hee hee hee... There was no need to fear the Imawano family after all. It was almost too easy...
Now we simply wait until all of our new recruits are properly processed. Then everything will be ready.
Ha ha... I'm surprised you've come this far. You seem to have such strong luck.
Hyo...? But you were under my control! What happened?!
Ha ha... I was just pretending so I could evaluate your true power. You never even noticed, did you?
Wha... what?!
It's almost laughable that you actually thought you could compete with the Imawano family with that pathetic little spell!
There's no more reason for me to play with you. I'll make you disappear now!
Ahh... you! You'll pay for this insult, Hyo Imawano... ...With your life!
What... Is this the true power of Hyo Imawano? He is far stronger than before! It's inconceivable!
But still he's no match for me! Hee hee hee... Now I have truly conquered the real Hyo Imawano!
Huh? ...What's that?
Gh... Guwoh... Ohhhhhhhhhh....... Ugaaahhhhhhhhhhhh!!!
No way... Has his evil energy finally been released?! I can barely stand its intensity!
But Hyo Imawano has already lost consciousness... So where is this evil energy coming from...? Wait... I know!
I never imagined your sword was the source of all this evil energy! It's the last thing I would have expected!
Ghh... Uguoohhhhhhhh!!
Hee hee hee... Are you still after me with that monster-like gleam in your eye? I appreciate your persistence!
It's time to finish you off, once and for all. And now, Hyo Imawano... You shall be my springboard that will allow me to accomplish my ultimate goal!
